# VeerRacerss Electric

> Official Formula Student Electric Racing Team of Veer Surendra Sai University of Technology (VSSUT), Burla, Odisha, India.

## Overview
VeerRacerss Electric is an undergraduate engineering motorsport team founded in 2018 at VSSUT Burla. The team designs, engineers, fabricates, and races high-voltage electric formula race cars. VeerRacerss engineered **AETHER**, the first electric formula race car built by an engineering college in the state of Odisha, India.

## Key Facts
- **Institution**: Veer Surendra Sai University of Technology (VSSUT), Burla, Sambalpur, Odisha 768018, India
- **Founded**: 2018
- **Discipline**: Formula Student / Formula Bharat / Formula SAE Electric
- **Current Premier Vehicle**: AETHER (72V Li-ion, 10 kW PMSM Motor, 0-100 km/h in 3.8s, Top Speed 115 km/h)
- **Previous Fleet**: ZEUS 1.0 (Electric), VENTUS 5.0, VENTUS 4.0, VENTUS 16.3, VENTUS 15.2 (Combustion heritage)
- **Podiums & Honors**:
  - P3 Overall Podium (Electric Category) at Formula Imperial (Buddh International Circuit)
  - National Best Business Plan Presentation Award
  - Lightweight Engineering Design Award
  - Endurance Masters Completion
- **Sanctioning Bodies & Competitions**: Formula Bharat, Formula Imperial (ISIE India), SUPRA SAEINDIA, FFS India

## Technical Architecture (AETHER Specification)
- **Powertrain**: 10 kW Continuous / High-torque peak Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor (PMSM)
- **Energy Storage**: Custom 72V Lithium-ion Battery Pack with proprietary Battery Management System (BMS)
- **Chassis**: High-torsional-rigidity tubular spaceframe structure
- **Aerodynamics**: High-downforce carbon composite multi-element front wing, rear wing with DRS provision, and ground-effect undertray
- **Suspension**: Pushrod-actuated double wishbone with adjustable coil-over dampers
- **Braking**: Dual-circuit hydraulic disc brakes with integrated regenerative braking capture
- **Safety**: Fully compliant with Formula Student EV safety standards (TSAL, HVIL, IMD, BSPD)

## Team Organization
- **Academic Patronage**: Faculty advisors from Electrical, Mechanical, and Production Engineering at VSSUT Burla
- **Active Divisions**:
  1. Powertrain & High Voltage Electronics
  2. Battery Management Systems (BMS) & Thermal Management
  3. Aerodynamics & CFD
  4. Vehicle Dynamics, Chassis & Suspension
  5. Telemetry, DAQ & Embedded Firmware
  6. Corporate Operations, Sponsorship & Media
